home.title: Your salon's bookings, online
home.subtitle: Clients book on their own from your link, any time. You manage locations, services and hours, even from your phone.

link.title: Your own link
link.text: Share it on WhatsApp, Instagram and Google: clients pick service, staff and time.

calendar.title: No double bookings
calendar.text: Free times account for shifts, holidays and existing appointments.

mail.title: Automatic confirmation
mail.text: Client and staff get an e-mail with the appointment to add to their calendar.

booking.title: Booking
booking.noServices: No services can be booked online right now.
booking.chooseStaff: Who would you like to book with?
booking.anyStaffHint: We'll assign the first person available
booking.noTimes: No free times in these days. Try “More days”.
booking.signInToConfirm: To confirm, sign in with your Google account so you can find and manage your bookings.
booking.phoneHint: With the country code, e.g. +44 7700 900123. Only used for reminders.
booking.notFoundHint: Check the link you received: the address may have changed.
booking.confirmedHint: We've e-mailed you the details and the appointment to add to your calendar.

myAppointments.title: My appointments
myAppointments.signInHint: Sign in with the same Google account you used to book.
myAppointments.deadline: You can reschedule or cancel until {{date}}, {{time}}.
myAppointments.tooLate: Less than {{hours}} hours to go: please contact the business for changes.
myAppointments.policy: You can reschedule or cancel up to {{hours}} hours before from “My appointments”.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your Google account to continue.

register.title: Register your business
register.subtitle: Create your business space: you will be its administrator.
register.name: Business name

slug.format: Only lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

interval.overlap: Time ranges on the same day overlap.

duration.invalid: Duration must be a multiple of 30 minutes (max 8 hours).

email.taken: A member with this e-mail already exists.
email.locked: A linked account's e-mail cannot be changed.

interval.overlap: Overlapping hours on the same day.

workingHours.locationNotAssigned: Location not assigned to this member.
workingHours.outsideOpeningHours: Some hours are outside the location's opening hours.

timeOff.order: The end date must be after the start date.

location.inUse: This location has appointments: deactivate it instead of deleting it.

service.inUse: This service has appointments: make it not bookable instead of deleting it.
service.notAvailable: This service cannot be booked at this location.

staff.inUse: This person has appointments: mark them as not working instead of deleting.
staff.notAvailable: The selected person is not available for this service.

slot.unavailable: This time is no longer available. Please choose another.
slot.taken: Someone just booked this time. Please choose another.

phone.invalid: Invalid number: include the country code (e.g. +44 7700 900123).

appointment.tooLate: It is too late to change this appointment: please contact the business.
appointment.notConfirmed: This appointment is no longer active.

dates.invalid: The end date must be on or after the start date (at most one year).

token.invalid: Invalid token. Copy it again from @BotFather.

telegram.webhookUnavailable: The server has no public https address configured for Telegram.
telegram.notConfigured: This business has no Telegram bot.

reminder.range: Choose a value between 0 and 168 hours.

dashboard.publicLink: Share this link with your clients: on WhatsApp, Instagram or Google.
dashboard.setupTitle: What's missing before you get bookings
dashboard.setupHint: Finish these steps and clients can book on their own.
dashboard.readyHint: Clients can already book from your link.

location.title: A location with opening hours
location.hint: Address and the days you're open.

services.title: At least one active service
services.hint: What you offer, how long it takes and the price.

staff.title: At least one staff member
staff.hint: Who does the services (it can be you).

hours.title: Staff working hours
hours.hint: The hours each person takes appointments.

rules.title: Client rules
rules.hint: How late clients can reschedule or cancel an appointment themselves.

reminders.title: Client reminders
reminders.hint: Automatic messages before the appointment (notification, Telegram and e-mail). They apply to new bookings.

calendar.noStaffForService: Nobody performs this service at this location.
calendar.notLinked: Your account is not linked to a staff member yet: ask the owner to add you with your e-mail.
calendar.dragHint: To change the time, drag the appointment in the calendar.

clients.search: Search by name, phone or e-mail
clients.empty: No clients yet: they will show up here after the first booking.

locations.confirmDelete: Delete the location “{{name}}”? It will also be removed from services and staff schedules.

services.empty: No services yet. Add the first one with “New service”.

staff.emailHint: When they sign in with this Google account they will see their space.
staff.emailLocked: The account is already linked: the e-mail cannot be changed.
staff.inviteInfo: Add members with their Google e-mail: they are linked on first sign-in.
staff.workingHoursHint: 1-hour blocks. Click cells, or a day name to fill it.
staff.noLocations: Assign at least one location to this member to set their hours.
staff.empty: No staff yet. Add yourself or your first staff member.

push.title: Notifications
push.client: Get an alert on your phone when a booking is confirmed, moved or cancelled.
push.staff: Get an alert on this device for every new booking, change or cancellation.
push.on: Notifications are on for this device.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. You can allow them again in the browser settings.
push.ios: On iPhone, first add this page to the Home Screen (Share → Add to Home Screen) and open it from there.
push.error: Notifications could not be turned on. Please try again.

announcements.intro: Tell your clients about closures, holiday hours or surcharges. The announcement shows on your booking page on the chosen days, and you can send it once to all clients by notification and e-mail.
announcements.messagePlaceholder: E.g. On 24 December we close at 2 pm. Public holidays carry a 10% surcharge.
announcements.notify: Send now to all clients by notification and e-mail ({{count}} clients)
announcements.confirmSend: Send this announcement to {{count}} clients by notification and e-mail? It can only be sent once.
announcements.empty: No announcements yet. Create the first one to keep your clients informed.

telegram.botHint: With a Telegram bot your clients and staff get confirmations, changes and announcements in a chat.
telegram.step2: Pick a name (e.g. your business name) and a username ending in "bot".
telegram.step3: Copy the token BotFather gives you and paste it below.
telegram.botConnected: The bot is active. Clients link it from "My bookings", staff from the dashboard.
telegram.confirmRemove: Disconnect the bot? Clients and staff will stop getting Telegram messages until you connect another one.
telegram.linkHint: Get confirmations and announcements in a chat with @{{bot}}, and book by writing to it.
telegram.linked: Linked: you get messages from @{{bot}} and can book in the chat.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.on: We remind you of your appointments the day before and shortly before.
reminders.off: You will not get reminders of your appointments.
